acts.title: Prologue
acts.arc: An ordinary night shift at the harbor, the train home and a quiet morning in Capsule 7B: the life about to be deleted.

beats.title: Glide to the harbor
beats.happens: See the city, settle beside the workplace at sundown.
beats.note: Cinematic, then a clear handover; no faction or name lesson.

beats.title: Walk to the supervisor
beats.happens: Walk to the supervisor; establish the hierarchy.
beats.note: One visible destination cue.

beats.title: The work tag
beats.happens: Receive a work tag and the first delivery assignment.
beats.note: A short instruction naming the visible crate and the receiving counter.

beats.title: First delivery
beats.happens: Carry a labelled parcel to the coworker.
beats.note: A wrong recipient gives a useful response and returns the item.

beats.title: The empty case
beats.happens: Return the coworker’s empty transport case to its rack.
beats.note: Same verbs, no repeated control lesson.

beats.title: The clamped trolley
beats.happens: Release a trolley wheel clamp, then move the trolley to the marked loading spot.
beats.note: The clamp has a readable state; no puzzle timing.

beats.title: Checkout
beats.happens: Return the work tag, check out and read the pay statement.
beats.note: The boss’s pressure is in the content: an unpaid minute on the statement.

beats.title: To the platform
beats.happens: Walk to the homeward train and board it.
beats.note: P7 in the plan, split by scene. Homebound boarding only.

beats.title: The train home
beats.happens: Ride home and leave at Downtown; an optional passenger conversation.
beats.note: Destination shown; no missed-train penalty or surprise destination.

beats.title: Downtown Metro
beats.happens: Leave the train at Downtown and head up to the street.
beats.note: P8 in the plan, split by scene.

beats.title: Breakfast at the stall
beats.place: Downtown street, the fixer’s noodle stall
beats.happens: Collect the usual breakfast at the fixer’s stall, then go home.
beats.note: Ordinary identity pays and opens the building. The fixer is recognised later.

beats.title: Home
beats.happens: Make a drink, greet Pixel, then rest.
beats.teaches: Household state and a deliberate transition
beats.note: Deletion begins only after the rest transition.

acts.title: Act I
acts.arc: Stripped of identity, wanting it back and learning to hack around the obstacles; it ends in a DLV-9 robot body.

beats.title: Identity not found
beats.happens: The door panel refuses: identity not found.

beats.title: Locked out
beats.happens: CONCIERGE will not help; the emergency exit works; locked out.
beats.note: Style frame dt-capsule-lobby (2026-10-22).

beats.title: The fixer remembers
beats.happens: The fixer remembers you; the till refuses payment; a referral to Kessel.

beats.title: Please hold
beats.happens: The official route: a ticket, a queue, “Please hold”, an appointment in 90 days.
beats.note: Style frame dt-registry (2026-10-22).

beats.title: The implant
beats.place: Kessel’s room, behind the fixer’s kitchen
beats.happens: The implant; the privacy shutter’s `open`.
beats.note: Style frame dt-kessel-clinic (2026-10-22).

beats.title: Back in
beats.happens: Back in through the service latch: `release`.
beats.note: Style frame dt-capsule-lobby (2026-10-22).

beats.title: Food without identity
beats.place: FRESHCO supermarket or the corner shop
beats.happens: Food without identity; the self-checkout accuses you; an event → action wire.
beats.note: FRESHCO supermarket would be new; the corner shop exists. Style frame dt-freshco (2026-10-22).

beats.title: The faulty sensor
beats.happens: A faulty sensor; cut the wire.
beats.note: Style frame dt-freshco (2026-10-22).

beats.title: Moth’s parcel
beats.happens: Moth’s parcel: cut and rewire.

beats.title: Moth’s door
beats.happens: The note’s phrase opens the door; the desk; a first known connection.
beats.note: The stairwell is new; the flat exists. Style frame dt-moth-stairwell (2026-10-22): 4C is the empty hideout, monitors still on, the pinned wall, things left in a hurry.

beats.title: It was deliberate
beats.happens: A public terminal: the deletion was deliberate; there is a list.

beats.title: Lights out
beats.happens: Cut the power to the block at the substation.
beats.note: Decided 2026-10-22 (Tommi): the combination challenge starts here, then the dark Registry. Style frame dt-substation.

beats.title: The dark Registry
beats.place: The Registry back office after hours
beats.happens: Into the dark Registry; restore the record by force at the local verification node; the backup power trips the alarm.
beats.note: Style frame dt-registry-night.

beats.title: The sweep
beats.place: A Downtown street at night, then Kessel’s room
beats.happens: A sweep collects unregistered persons; Kessel’s emergency transfer into DLV-9.
beats.note: The street’s sweep variant and Kessel’s room are new. Style frame dt-sweep (2026-10-22): vans with light bars, floodlight towers, the checkpoint by the van, notices and a red ticker, people hiding.

acts.title: Act I · optional places
acts.arc: Breathers and side errands in Downtown between the required steps.

beats.title: The 24h diner
beats.happens: Breakfast at dawn with the night shift; a Registry inspector at the counter.
beats.note: Optional place; style frame dt-diner (2026-10-22).

beats.title: The roofs
beats.happens: Downtown from above; the Registry Premium billboard; someone sheltering behind it.
beats.note: Optional place; style frame dt-roofs (2026-10-22).

beats.title: The precinct
beats.happens: The front desk will not take a report from someone who does not exist; the Registry keeps a liaison desk here, and the holding cells wait for its collection.
beats.note: Optional place; style frame dt-precinct (2026-10-22): front desk, wanted and unregistered board, Registry liaison office, holding cells, squad room, evidence cage.

acts.title: Act II
acts.arc: Waking up as DLV-9; the goal is the body.

beats.title: Wake up as DLV-9
beats.happens: Wake up as DLV-9; the goal is the body.
